conclusion: The generic controller can be reused through explicit typed symbol bindings and proven identity/notification providers. Neither public-table casting nor same-size coordinator-view casting establishes integration.

findings.public_table: ARM32 source model: ABI-version word plus 8 pointers = 36B; old adapter core role table 10 pointers = 40B. Role order differs. Both complete signatures and ordinal mapping are in comparison.json.
findings.coordinator: 15 identical four-byte fields give 60B ARM32 source model in old view, finite coordinator and continuous coordinator. Storage equality does not establish finite/continuous ticket, rearm, source retirement or counter semantics.
findings.identity: Controller generation/admission epoch, software session epoch, native ownership witness epoch, ownership cookie, Source actor and recyclable FIFO tickets remain separate identity domains.
findings.persistent_token: Old publication requires coordinator.ticket = output.active_ticket with a live matching slot. Current registration_ticket is a bootstrap audit seed while FIFO slots may be released/reused. A durable native anchor/node-generation token and its publication/cleanup mapping remain unbound.
findings.notifications: Typed source_started and cleanup_returned APIs exist. Current Source publication and complete original cleanup return need exact same route/generation/cookie/persistent token; their actual production notification ingress is not established by this review.
findings.stop: Cancel accepted/process-returned/native cleanup-completed/STOP_DONE are distinct. Core complete predicate and old observer strategy are reusable; current provider storage, ownership/witness epoch, causal iteration, wake-to-service loop and full-return provenance require rebinding.
findings.lifetime: Distinct cleanup, pull and event frames carry different identities and leases. Do not cast/overlay frames or remove leases. Module/context residency and future callback exclusion remain required.

scope_limits.absence_claims: Limited to reviewed source family/captures; not a whole-project caller, symbol-retention or hook absence claim.

closure_method: Hash closure of exactly emitted small artifacts and their final size/mode/stat. Fresh three source stats rechecked without body reread. No independent candidate/native/whole-image readback.
